# drawbridge — game and game-adjacent domains
#
# App installs are stopped by `blocked_packages`; this list closes the browser
# route to the same games, and the Minecraft Bedrock multiplayer servers.
#
# NOTE ON MINECRAFT: the game itself is deliberately NOT blocked — neither the
# package nor minecraft.net. Only Realms and the large public Bedrock servers
# are listed. A DNS blocklist cannot stop a server joined by raw IP address, and
# it cannot enumerate the thousands of small servers that exist, so this is a
# speed bump rather than a wall. Treat single-player and LAN as allowed.

# Roblox
roblox.com
rbxcdn.com
roblox.qq.com

# Fortnite / Epic
fortnite.com
epicgames.com
unrealengine.com
easyantcheat.net

# Supercell
brawlstars.com
supercell.com

# Among Us
innersloth.com
among-us.net

# Call of Duty
callofduty.com
codmobile.com

# PUBG
pubgmobile.com
pubg.com

# Free Fire
ff.garena.com
garena.com
freefiremobile.com

# Rockstar / GTA
rockstargames.com
socialclub.rockstargames.com

# Social VR

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# European Parent Safety Catalogue — added with policy 21.
#
# Publisher domains where the publisher only makes games, game domains where
# the game has its own site. Every entry below was resolved before being added;
# candidates that had lapsed to squatters or to an unrelated business were
# dropped rather than listed. Notably absent for that reason: frostpunkmobile.com
# (now a gambling site, and covered by the gambling list anyway), wwemayhem.com
# (a fan forum), nuverse.com (a financial firm, not the games publisher).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
